articles.title: Addressing threats to future global health-what is the right timeframe?
articles.authors: Andreou C, Budolfson M, Campbell T, Ferranna M, Herlitz A, Kosonen P, Kowalczyk K, Lerner AJ, et al.

abstract.text: Our decisions today can support or threaten future human health. Insofar as we protect the planet or invest in fruitful research on pandemic countermeasures, we promote future wellbeing and health, sometimes at the present generation's expense. As we warm the planet, accelerate antibiotic resistance, or consume finite natural resources, we might serve present-day wellbeing or health at the expense of future generations. To decide which such trade-offs are legitimate or advisable, we need to know how to balance the health interests of future generations against each other and against our own. Should concerns for future health be confined to the 21st century as per the stated mission of the Lancet Commission on 21st century global threats to health? If not, how far into the future should they extend, and why? Population ethics is a branch of ethics that considers future populations' wellbeing. This Review, a part of the Lancet Commission on 21st century global threats to health, applies general insights from population ethics to future populations' health, and shows why that application is more complex than meets the eye.
abstract.textZh: 我們今天的決定可能支持或威脅未來的人類健康。 只要我們保護地球或投資於對流行病對策的富有成效的研究，我們就會促進未來的福祉和健康，有時會以當代人為代價。 當我們使地球變暖、加速抗生素耐藥性或消耗有限的自然資源時，我們可能會以犧牲子孫後代為代價，為當今的福祉或健康服務。 要決定哪些權衡是合法或可取的，我們需要知道如何平衡未來世代的健康利益。 根據柳葉刀委員會關於21世紀全球健康威脅的既定使命，對未來健康的關注是否應僅限於21世紀？ 如果沒有，它們應該延伸到多遠的未來？為什麼？ 人口倫理是倫理學的一個分支，考慮未來人口的福祉。 本評論是柳葉刀委員會關於21世紀全球健康威脅的一部分，將人口倫理學的一般見解應用於未來人口的健康，並展示了為什麼該應用比眼前更複雜。

articles.title: 8 weeks versus 12 weeks of sofosbuvir-velpatasvir for treatment-naive, non-cirrhotic, chronic hepatitis C (RESOLVE): a multicentre, open-label, non-inferiority, randomised controlled trial in India
articles.authors: Goel A, Rungta S, Kumar V, Shalimar, Kumar A, Katiyar H, Singh S, Deep A, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection without cirrhosis can be treated with 12 weeks of sofosbuvir-velpatasvir combination therapy. We aimed to assess whether a shorter 8-week treatment regimen of this combination was non-inferior to the standard 12-week regimen in successfully clearing HCV infection in HCV-infected patients without evidence of cirrhosis.
abstract.textZh: 沒有肝硬化的慢性丙型肝炎病毒（ HCV ）感染可以使用12週的sofosbuvir-velpatasvir聯合治療來治療。我們旨在評估在沒有肝硬化證據的HCV感染患者中，該組合的短期8週治療方案在成功清除HCV感染方面是否不劣於標準的12週方案。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: RESOLVE was a multicentre, open-label, non-inferiority, randomised controlled trial, conducted in five publicly funded hospitals in India. We randomly assigned (1:1) treatment-naive adults (aged ≥18 years) with non-cirrhotic HCV mono-infection to receive sofosbuvir 400 mg and velpatasvir 100 mg (orally, daily) for either 8 weeks or 12 weeks. The primary outcome was the proportion of participants with sustained virological response-ie, absence of quantifiable HCV RNA at 12 weeks after treatment completion (SVR12), with 95% assumed proportion with 12-week treatment, 5% non-inferiority margin, 2·5% one-sided alpha error, and 90% study power in the per-protocol population. The trial was registered with the Clinical Trial Registry of India, CTRI/2022/03/041368, and is complete.
abstract.textZh: RESOLVE是一項多中心、開放標籤、非劣效性、隨機對照試驗，在印度五家公立醫院進行。我們隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ）未接受治療的成年人（年齡≥ 18歲）非肝硬化HCV單一感染，接受索非布韋400毫克和維帕他韋100毫克（口服，每日） ，持續8週或12週。主要結果是持續病毒學反應的受試者比例-即治療完成後12週時缺乏可量化的HCV RNA （ SVR12 ） ，在符合方案的人羣中，假設12週治療的HCV RNA比例為95% ，非劣效性邊際為5% ，單側α誤差為2.5% ，研究能力為90%。該試驗已在印度臨牀試驗註冊處（ CTRI/2022/03/041368 ）註冊，並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between May 15, 2022, and Sept 10, 2024, we screened 1620 participants, of whom 880 (54·3%) were enrolled in the study and randomly assigned to the 12-week (n=437 [50%]) or 8-week (n=443 [50%]) groups. 455 (52%) participants were women, 425 (48%) were men, and the median age was 35 years (IQR 28 to 47). 816 (93%) participants completed the intended 12-week (401 [92%] of 437) or 8-week (415 [94%] of 443) treatment and SVR12 testing. On per-protocol analysis, the proportion reaching SVR12 with 8-week treatment (410/415; 98·8% [95% CI 97·2 to 99·6]) was non-inferior to 12-week treatment (397/401; 99·0% [97·5 to 99·7]), with a risk difference of 0·2% (-1·5 to 1·9). Further, on intention-to-treat analysis, the proportion of participants reaching SVR12 with 8-week treatment (414/443; 93·5% [90·9 to 95·5]) was non-inferior to 12-week treatment (401/437; 91·8% [88·8 to 94·2]) with a risk difference of -1·7% (-5·2 to 1·9). No participant had any drug-related serious adverse event or drug discontinuation due to an adverse event.
abstract.textZh: 在2022年5月15日至2024年9月10日期間，我們篩選了1620名參與者，其中880名（ 54.3 ％ ）被納入研究並隨機分配到12週（ n = 437 [50 ％] ）或8週（ n = 443 [50 ％] ）組。455名（ 52 ％ ）參與者為女性， 425名（ 48 ％ ）為男性，中位年齡為35歲（ IQR 28至47 ）。816名（ 93 ％ ）參與者完成了預期的12週（ 401 [92 ％]的437 ）或8週（ 415 [94 ％]的443 ）治療和SVR12測試。 在符合方案分析中， 8週治療(410/415; 98 · 8% [95% CI 97 · 2至99 · 6])達到SVR12的比例不劣於12週治療(397/401; 99 · 0% [97 · 5至99 · 7]) ，風險差異為0 · 2% (-1 · 5至1 · 9)。 此外，在意向性治療分析中， 8週治療（ 414/443 ； 93 · 5% [90 · 9至95 · 5] ）達到SVR12的參與者比例不劣於12週治療（ 401/437 ； 91 · 8% [88 · 8至94 · 2] ） ，風險差異為-1 · 7% （ -5 · 2至1 · 9 ）。 沒有參與者因不良事件而出現任何與藥物相關的嚴重不良事件或停藥。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: An 8-week regimen of sofosbuvir-velpatasvir was similar in efficacy to the standard 12-week treatment in individuals with chronic HCV infection without cirrhosis. This finding supports shortening the duration of treatment in such patients.
abstract.textZh: 在沒有肝硬化的慢性HCV感染個體中， 8週的sofosbuvir-velpatasvir治療方案與標準12週治療方案的療效相似。這一發現支持縮短這類患者的治療持續時間。

articles.title: Cardiovascular safety of orforglipron versus insulin glargine in adults with type 2 diabetes at increased cardiovascular risk (ACHIEVE-4): a phase 3, event-driven, randomised, open-label, non-inferiority, active comparator trial
articles.authors: Klein KR, Wysham C, Tuttle KR, Davies MJ, Cox D, Chen J, Wu WS, Denning M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Orforglipron is an oral, non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonist. While some peptide GLP-1 receptor agonists have established cardiovascular benefit, the cardiovascular safety of non-peptide GLP-1 receptor agonists has not been studied. This study aimed to compare the effect of orforglipron with insulin glargine on the incidence of major adverse cardiovascular events in individuals with type 2 diabetes and obesity or overweight who are at increased risk for cardiovascular events.
abstract.textZh: Orforglipron是一種口服、非肽GLP-1受體激動劑。雖然一些肽GLP-1受體激動劑已經確立了心血管益處，但尚未研究非肽GLP-1受體激動劑的心血管安全性。本研究旨在比較orforglipron與甘精胰島素對心血管事件風險增加的2型糖尿病和肥胖或超重患者主要不良心血管事件發生的影響。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This event-driven, phase 3, multicentre, randomised, open-label, active comparator, parallel-group study was conducted in 317 sites across 16 countries and territories. Adults with type 2 diabetes at increased cardiovascular risk with glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) concentrations between 7·0% and 10·5% (53-91 mmol/mol) and a BMI of 25 kg/m2 or more, treated with up to three glucose-lowering medications (metformin, a sulfonylurea, and/or an SGLT2 inhibitor), were randomly assigned (1:1) to oral orforglipron maximum tolerated dose (up to 36 mg capsule [equivalent to 17·2 mg tablet]) or injectable titrated insulin glargine, each administered once daily. All participants had established cardiovascular or chronic kidney disease. The primary outcome was time to occurrence of four-component major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE-4), including cardiovascular death, non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or hospitalisation for unstable angina. Non-inferiority of orforglipron to insulin glargine was declared if the upper limit of the two-sided 95% CI for the hazard ratio (HR; orforglipron vs insulin glargine) was less than 1·8. The primary endpoint and other safety endpoints were assessed in all participants who took at least one dose of assigned treatment using all datapoints from baseline until withdrawal or study completion, regardless of treatment adherence. This trial was registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05803421) and is completed.
abstract.textZh: 這項事件驅動的3期、多中心、隨機、開放標籤、積極對照、平行組研究在16個國家和地區的317個研究中心進行。 心血管疾病風險增加的2型糖尿病成人，糖化血紅蛋白(HbA1c)濃度介於7.0%至10.5% (53-91 mmol/mol)之間， BMI為25 kg/m2或以上，使用最多三種降糖藥物(二甲雙胍、磺酰脲和/或SGLT2抑制劑)治療，隨機(1: 1)分配至口服或格列酮最大耐受劑量(最多36毫克膠囊[相當於17.2毫克片劑])或可注射滴定甘精胰島素，每日一次。 所有參與者都患有心血管疾病或慢性腎臟疾病。 主要結果是發生四組分主要心血管不良事件（ MACE-4 ）的時間，包括心血管死亡、非致命性心肌梗塞、非致命性中風或不穩定心絞痛住院。 如果風險比(HR; orforglipron vs insulin glargine)的雙側95% CI的上限小於1.8 ，則宣告orforglipron與甘精胰島素的非劣效性。 使用從基線到退出或研究完成的所有數據點，在所有服用至少一劑指定治療藥物的參與者中評估主要終點和其他安全性終點，無論治療依從性如何。 本試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT05803421 ）上註冊並已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between May 1, 2023, and Sept 5, 2024, 2749 participants were randomly assigned (1371 to orforglipron and 1378 to insulin glargine). 1032 (38%) participants were female and 1717 (62·5%) male. 2362 (85·9%) participants had established cardiovascular disease and 1033 (37·6%) had chronic kidney disease. Mean baseline age, HbA1c, and BMI were 63·1 years (SD 9·9), 8·2% (1·0), and 33 kg/m2 (6·2), respectively. Over a median follow-up of 2 years, the primary outcome occurred in 57 (4·2%) of 1358 orforglipron participants and 67 (5·0%) of 1343 insulin glargine participants, showing non-inferiority to insulin glargine for MACE-4 (HR 0·84; 95% CI 0·59-1·20; p<0·0001 for non-inferiority). Gastrointestinal adverse events were reported in 851 (62·1%) of 1371 orforglipron participants and 193 (14·2%) of 1355 insulin glargine participants; clinically significant or severe hypoglycaemia (glucose <3 mmol/L [54 mg/dL]) occurred in 93 (6·8%) of 1371 orforglipron participants and 260 (19·2%) of 1355 insulin glargine participants. 62 deaths were reported during the study: 19 (1·4%) of 1371 participants receiving orforglipron and 43 (3·2%) of 1355 participants receiving insulin glargine; all deaths except one (in the insulin glargine group) were deemed unrelated to treatment.
abstract.textZh: 在2023年5月1日至2024年9月5日期間， 2749名參與者被隨機分配（ 1371名參與者被分配至orforglipron ， 1378名參與者被分配至甘精胰島素）。1032名參與者（ 38 ％ ）為女性， 1717名參與者（ 62.5 ％ ）為男性。2362名參與者（ 85.9 ％ ）已確立心血管疾病， 1033名參與者（ 37.6 ％ ）患有慢性腎病。 平均基線年齡、HbA1c和BMI分別為63 · 1年(SD 9 · 9)、8 · 2% (1 · 0)和33 kg/m2 (6 · 2)。 在2年的中位隨訪期間，主要結果發生在1358名orforglipron參與者中的57名（ 4.2% ）和1343名甘精胰島素參與者中的67名（ 5.0% ） ，在MACE-4方面顯示出與甘精胰島素相比的非劣效性（ HR 0.84 ； 95% CI 0.59-1.20 ；非劣效性p < 0.0001 ）。 1371名Orforglipron參與者中有851名(62 · 1%)和1355名甘精胰島素參與者中有193名(14 · 2%)報告了胃腸道不良事件； 1371名Orforglipron參與者中有93名(6 · 8%)和1355名甘精胰島素參與者中有260名(19 · 2%)發生了臨牀顯著或嚴重的低血糖(葡萄糖< 3 mmol/L [54 mg/dL])。研究期間報告了62例死亡： 1371名參與者中有19名(1 · 4%)接受Orforglipron ， 1355名參與者中有43名(3 · 2%)接受甘精胰島素；除一例(甘精胰島素組)以外的所有死亡被認為與治療無關。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: In people with type 2 diabetes at increased cardiovascular risk, the cardiovascular safety of orforglipron was confirmed by demonstrating non-inferiority to insulin glargine for MACE-4. Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most frequent adverse event and most common reason for orforglipron treatment discontinuation with orforglipron, while clinically significant hypoglycaemia occurred less frequently with orforglipron than with insulin glargine. These findings support orforglipron as a potential once-daily, oral treatment option with established cardiovascular safety in people with type 2 diabetes and increased cardiovascular risk.
abstract.textZh: 在心血管風險增加的2型糖尿病患者中，通過證明MACE-4對甘精胰島素的非劣效性，確認了奧福格列龍的心血管安全性。胃腸道不良事件是orforglipron停止使用orforglipron治療最常見的不良事件和最常見的原因，而臨牀上顯著的低血糖症使用orforglipron比使用甘精胰島素發生的頻率更低。這些發現支持orforglipron作為一種潛在的每日一次的口服治療選擇，在患有2型糖尿病和心血管風險增加的人羣中具有既定的心血管安全性。

articles.title: Efficacy and safety of garetosmab, an activin A-blocking antibody, in fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (OPTIMA): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
articles.authors: Papa R, Rhee S, Delai P, Zhang K, Balcázar IB, Rethanavelu K, Fujiwara T, Mishima K, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva (FOP) is an ultrarare genetic disorder resulting in progressive heterotopic ossification of ligaments, tendons, and muscles, leading to disability and early mortality. FOP is caused by heterozygous gain-of-function mutations in the activin receptor type 1A, allowing this receptor to be aberrantly activated by activin A (ActA), which normally inhibits this receptor, thus driving heterotopic bone formation. In preclinical models and an earlier phase 2 trial (LUMINA-1) in FOP, an antibody blocking ActA (garetosmab) prevented heterotopic ossification. We aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of garetosmab in adults living with FOP.
abstract.textZh: 進行性纖維異形成骨化症（ FOP ）是一種超罕見的遺傳性疾病，導致韌帶、肌腱和肌肉的進行性異位骨化，導致殘疾和早期死亡。FOP是由活化素受體1A型中的雜合功能獲得突變引起的，允許該受體被通常抑制該受體的活化素A （ ActA ）異常激活，從而驅動異位骨形成。在臨牀前模型和FOP的早期2期試驗（ LUMINA-1 ）中，抗體阻斷ActA （ garetosmab ）預防異位骨化。我們的目標是評估garetosmab在患有FOP的成年人中的有效性和安全性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: OPTIMA is a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial conducted at 18 study sites across 16 countries and regions. Participants aged 18 years or older with FOP were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to monthly intravenous placebo, garetosmab 3 mg/kg, or garetosmab 10 mg/kg. Randomisation was stratified by baseline Cumulative Analogue Joint Involvement Scale score and previous participation in the LUMINA-1 study. The primary efficacy and safety endpoints were total number of new heterotopic bone lesions at week 56 and treatment-emergent adverse events of special interest (AESIs) through week 56, analysed in all randomised participants who received at least one dose of the study drug. This trial is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT05394116); the trial is active (completed primary endpoint) but not recruiting participants.
abstract.textZh: OPTIMA是一項隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照的3期試驗，在16個國家和地區的18個研究中心進行。將18歲或以上患有FOP的參與者隨機(1: 1: 1)分配至每月靜脈注射安慰劑、garetosmab 3 mg/kg或garetosmab 10 mg/kg。隨機分組根據基線期累積類比關節受累量表評分和先前參與LUMINA-1研究的情況進行分層。主要療效和安全性終點為第56週時新發異位骨病竈的總數，以及第56週時治療中出現的特殊關注不良事件(AESI) ，在所有接受至少一劑研究藥物的隨機分組參與者中進行分析。此試驗已在ClinicalTrials.gov （ NCT05394116 ）註冊；試驗有效（已完成主要終點） ，但不招募參與者。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between Nov 21, 2022, and July 4, 2024, 63 participants were enrolled and randomly assigned (placebo, n=21; garetosmab 3 mg/kg, n=19; garetosmab 10 mg/kg, n=23). The mean age was 26·6 years (SD 6·8); 38 (60%) participants were female and 25 (40%) male. 62 participants completed 56 weeks of treatment; one participant in the placebo group discontinued at 53 weeks. The total number of new heterotopic bone lesions was significantly lower with garetosmab: there were 19 lesions with placebo versus one lesion with garetosmab 3 mg/kg (rate ratio vs placebo: 0·06 [95% CI 0·00-0·73]; p=0·027) and two lesions with garetosmab 10 mg/kg (rate ratio vs placebo: 0·10 [0·01-0·76]; p=0·026). Treatment-emergent AESIs occurred in one (5%) of 21 participants receiving placebo, zero of 19 receiving garetosmab 3 mg/kg, and four (17%) of 23 receiving garetosmab 10 mg/kg; all were considered treatment-related. No deaths occurred.
abstract.textZh: 在2022年11月21日至2024年7月4日期間，入組並隨機分配了63名參與者（安慰劑， n = 21 ； garetosmab 3 mg/kg ， n = 19 ； garetosmab 10 mg/kg ， n = 23 ）。平均年齡為26 · 6歲(SD 6 · 8) ； 38 (60%)名參與者為女性， 25 (40%)名為男性。62名參與者完成了56週的治療；安慰劑組的一名參與者在53週時停藥。使用garetosmab時，新的異位骨病竈總數顯著較低：使用安慰劑的病竈有19個，而使用garetosmab 3 mg/kg的病竈有1個（速率比率與安慰劑： 0 · 06 [95% CI 0 · 00-0 · 73] ； p = 0 · 027 ） ，使用garetosmab 10 mg/kg的病竈有2個（速率比率與安慰劑： 0 · 10 [0 · 01-0 · 76] ； p = 0 · 026 ）。21名接受安慰劑的參與者中有1名（ 5% ）發生治療中出現的AESI ， 19名接受3 mg/kg garetosmab的參與者中有0名， 23名接受10 mg/kg garetosmab的參與者中有4名（ 17% ）發生治療中出現的AESI ；均被認為與治療相關。未發生死亡。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Garetosmab substantially reduced the number of new heterotopic bone lesions, providing robust evidence of its potential to be an efficacious and generally well tolerated disease-modifying therapy for FOP.
abstract.textZh: Garetosmab大大減少了新的異位骨病竈的數量，提供了有力的證據，證明其有可能成為FOP的有效且通常耐受性良好的疾病修飾療法。

articles.title: Immunogenicity of fractional one-fifth and one-half doses of 17DD yellow fever vaccine compared with full dose in children aged 9-23 months in Uganda: a phase 4, single-blind, randomised clinical trial
articles.authors: Doshi RH, Lubega I, Muhoza P, Carlock G, Sekiziyivu AB, Tuttle A, Najjengo M, Kayiwa J, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Fractional doses of yellow fever vaccines have been shown to be safe and immunogenic in randomised controlled trials in adults and children. However, little evidence still remains in children younger than 2 years. We assessed immunogenicity of one-fifth (0·1 mL) and one-half (0·25 mL) fractional doses compared with full doses of 17DD yellow fever vaccine in children aged 9-23 months in Kampala, Uganda.
abstract.textZh: 在成人和兒童的隨機對照試驗中，部分劑量的黃熱病疫苗已被證明是安全和免疫原性的。然而， 2歲以下兒童的證據仍然很少。我們評估了烏幹達坎帕拉9-23個月兒童的五分之一（ 0 · 1mL ）和二分之一（ 0 · 25mL ）分次劑量與全劑量17DD黃熱病疫苗的免疫原性。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: This phase 4, single-blind, randomised clinical trial evaluating fractional dose 17DD yellow fever vaccine among children was conducted at three public-sector health facilities in Uganda. Eligible participants were aged 9-23 months at enrolment, had no history of yellow fever disease or vaccination, and did not meet the exclusion criteria. Children were enrolled in three age strata: 9-12 months, 13-18 months, and 19-23 months, and were randomly assigned (1:1:1) using block randomisation (block sizes of three and six) to one-fifth (0·1 mL), one-half (0·25 mL), or full (0·5 mL) doses of the 17DD yellow fever vaccine. Participants were followed up at 4 weeks (visit 1 [V1]), 1 year (visit 2 [V2]), and 13-48 months (visit 3 [V3]) after vaccination. The primary analysis included per-protocol participants who attended within the prespecified visit window; an intention-to-treat analysis was also conducted including all randomly assigned participants with available outcome data. Participants with missing serological data were excluded from the analysis at the corresponding visit. The primary outcome was non-inferiority in seroconversion (5 percentage-point margin) at V1 measured by 50% plaque reduction neutralisation test. This study is registered with ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT03725618, and is complete.
abstract.textZh: 這項評估兒童接種分次劑量17DD黃熱病疫苗的第4期單盲隨機臨牀試驗在烏幹達的三個公共衛生機構進行。 符合資格的參與者在入組時年齡為9-23個月，沒有黃熱病史或疫苗接種史，不符合排除標準。 兒童入組三個年齡層： 9-12個月、13-18個月和19-23個月，並使用塊隨機分配（塊大小為3和6 ）至五分之一（ 0 · 1mL ）、一半（ 0 · 25mL ）或完整（ 0 · 5mL ）劑量的17DD黃熱病疫苗隨機分配（ 1 ： 1 ： 1 ）。 參與者在疫苗接種後第4週（回診1 [V1] ）、第1年（回診2 [V2] ）和第13-48個月（回診3 [V3] ）進行追蹤。 主要分析包括在預先指定的回診時段內參加的符合方案的參與者；還進行了意向治療分析，其中包括所有可用結果數據的隨機分配參與者。 缺少血清學數據的參與者被排除在相應回診的分析之外。 主要結果是通過50 ％斑塊減少中和測試測得的V1血清轉換的非劣效性（ 5個百分點邊際）。 本研究已在ClinicalTrials.gov註冊，編號為NCT03725618 ，已完成。

abstract.label: FINDINGS
abstract.text: Between March 26, 2019, and May 11, 2021, 1784 participants were randomly assigned to either one-fifth dose (n=600), one-half dose (n=594), or full dose (n=590). The median (IQR) age at enrolment was 13 (11-18) months. Both fractional doses met the non-inferiority criterion compared with the full dose with no difference in seroconversion between one-fifth and full doses and -0·17 (95% CI -0·52 to 0·17) difference between one-half and full doses in the per-protocol population at V1. There was no difference between the one-fifth and full doses.
abstract.textZh: 在2019年3月26日至2021年5月11日期間， 1784名參與者被隨機分配到五分之一劑量（ n = 600 ）、一半劑量（ n = 594 ）或全劑量（ n = 590 ）。入組時的中位數(IQR)年齡為13 (11-18)個月。與全劑量相比，兩種分數劑量均符合非劣效性標準，在V1期間，符合方案的人羣中，五分之一劑量和全劑量之間的血清轉換沒有差異，半劑量和全劑量之間的差異為-0 · 17 (95% CI -0 · 52至0 · 17)。五分之一劑量和全劑量之間沒有差異。

abstract.label: INTERPRETATION
abstract.text: Both fractional doses of 17DD yellow fever vaccine were non-inferior to full doses in inducing initial seroconversion. The results support the use of fractional dose yellow fever vaccines among young children for outbreak response during supply shortages.
abstract.textZh: 兩種分次劑量的17DD黃熱病疫苗在誘導初始血清轉換方面都不劣於全劑量。結果支持在供應短缺期間在幼兒中使用部分劑量的黃熱病疫苗以應對疫情。

articles.title: Adult Attention Deficit-Hyperactivity Disorder
articles.authors: Buitelaar JK, Newcorn JH

abstract.text: Attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a medical condition that is present in approximately 2.5% of adults worldwide and manifests in a variety of different ways across the lifespan. Adults with ADHD often have coexisting psychiatric disorders such as anxiety, mood, sleep, substance use, and personality disorders and are at increased risk for coexisting somatic conditions such as obesity, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular disease, type 1 and type 2 diabetes, and immune and inflammatory conditions. Hence, such adults may be seen by clinicians providing care for a wide range of psychiatric and somatic conditions. Nevertheless, ADHD remains unrecognized and undiagnosed in many persons. Assessment requires interviewing of the patient for core ADHD symptoms, coexisting conditions, and their functional effects, which can be facilitated by using standardized rating scales. Key components of treatment are psychoeducation and psychostimulant or nonstimulant medication, mostly in combination with psychosocial interventions and lifestyle guidance.
abstract.textZh: 注意力缺陷多動障礙（ ADHD ）是一種醫療狀況，存在於全球約2.5 ％的成年人中，並在整個生命週期中以各種不同的方式表現出來。 患有ADHD的成年人通常患有共存的精神疾病，如焦慮、情緒、睡眠、物質使用和人格障礙，並且患有共存的軀體疾病的風險增加，如肥胖、心血管疾病和腦血管疾病、1型和2型糖尿病，以及免疫和炎症狀況。 因此，提供各種精神和身體疾病護理的臨牀醫生可能會看到這些成年人。 儘管如此，在許多人中， ADHD仍未被識別和診斷。 評估需要對患者進行核心ADHD症狀、共存狀況及其功能影響的訪談，這可以通過使用標準化的評分量表來促進。 治療的關鍵組成部分是心理教育和精神興奮劑或非興奮劑藥物，主要與心理社會幹預和生活方式指導相結合。

articles.title: Long-Acting HIV Therapy in African Adults with Adherence Challenges
articles.authors: Cresswell FV, Kitonsa J, Norcross C, Tumusiime V, Ombajo LA, Garrett N, Kassim S, Owarwo NC, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: In eastern and southern Africa, approximately 1 million people living with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and receiving oral therapy do not have viral suppression because of adherence challenges.
abstract.textZh: 在非洲東部和南部，由於依從性挑戰，約有100萬人感染人類免疫缺陷病毒（ HIV ）並接受口服治療的人沒有病毒抑制。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a phase 3b, open-label, randomized trial to compare long-acting injectable cabotegravir plus rilpivirine with oral dolutegravir-based therapy among adults with virally suppressed HIV type 1 (viral load, <200 copies per milliliter) and suboptimal adherence or care engagement. The participants were assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive intramuscular injections of cabotegravir (600 mg) plus rilpivirine (900 mg) every 8 weeks, with the first two injection visits occurring 4 weeks apart, or to continue daily oral dolutegravir-based therapy; baseline drug-resistance testing was not performed. The primary end point was a viral load of less than 50 copies per milliliter at week 48; noninferiority was assessed with a margin of -10 percentage points. Confirmed virologic failure (two consecutive viral loads of ≥200 copies per milliliter) was a key secondary end point.
abstract.textZh: 我們進行了一項3b期、開放標籤、隨機試驗，在HIV 1型病毒抑制（病毒載量， < 200拷貝/毫升）和次優依從性或照護參與的成年人中，比較長效注射型卡博替拉韋加利匹韋林與口服dolutegravir治療。以1: 1的比例分配參與者每8週接受一次卡博替拉韋(600 mg)加利匹韋林(900 mg)的肌肉注射，前兩次注射回診間隔4週，或繼續每日口服以dolutegravir為基礎的治療；未進行基線耐藥性測試。主要終點是第48週時病毒載量低於50拷貝/毫升；以-10個百分點的邊際評估非劣效性。確認的病毒學失敗（兩個連續的病毒載量≥ 200拷貝/毫升）是關鍵的次要終點。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 540 participants were enrolled across seven sites in Kenya, South Africa, and Uganda; 537 were included in the primary analysis. At 48 weeks, 244 of 268 participants (91.0%) in the long-acting-therapy group had a viral load of less than 50 copies per milliliter, as compared with 240 of 269 participants (89.2%) in the oral-therapy group (risk difference, 1.9 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -3.1 to 6.9), which met the criterion for noninferiority. The results of a per-protocol analysis were consistent with those of the primary analysis. Confirmed virologic failure occurred in 5 participants (1.9%) in the long-acting-therapy group and in no participants in the oral-therapy group (risk difference, 1.9 percentage points; 95% CI, 0.3 to 3.5). Serious adverse events were reported in 11 of 271 participants (4.1%) who received long-acting therapy and in 8 of 269 participants (3.0%) who received oral therapy (risk difference, 1.1 percentage points; 95% CI, -1.1 to 4.2).
abstract.textZh: 在肯亞、南非和烏幹達的七個研究中心共招募了540名參與者； 537名參與者被納入主要療效分析。 在48週時，長效治療組的268名參與者中有244名（ 91.0 ％ ）的病毒載量低於每毫升50拷貝，而口服治療組的269名參與者中有240名（ 89.2 ％ ） （風險差異， 1.9個百分點； 95 ％置信區間[CI] ， -3.1至6.9 ）符合非劣效性標準。 符合方案分析的結果與主要療效分析的結果一致。 確認病毒學失敗發生在長效治療組的5名參與者（ 1.9% ）和口服治療組的無參與者中（風險差異， 1.9個百分點； 95% CI ， 0.3至3.5 ）。 接受長效治療的271名參與者中有11名（ 4.1% ）報告了嚴重不良事件，接受口服治療的269名參與者中有8名（ 3.0% ）報告了嚴重不良事件（風險差異， 1.1個百分點； 95% CI ， -1.1至4.2 ）。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among persons with HIV in Africa who have adherence challenges, long-acting cabotegravir plus rilpivirine was noninferior to oral dolutegravir-based therapy for maintaining a viral load of less than 50 copies per milliliter. (Funded by Johnson & Johnson; IMPALA ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT05546242; Pan African Clinical Trials Registry number, PACT202301600757432TMC278LAHTX3005.).
abstract.textZh: 在非洲有依從性挑戰的HIV患者中，長效cabotegravir加上rilpivirine在維持病毒載量低於每毫升50拷貝的口服dolutegravir治療方面不劣於口服dolutegravir治療。（由強生公司資助； IMPALA ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT05546242 ；泛非臨牀試驗註冊號， PACT202301600757432TMC278LAHTX3005 ）。

articles.title: Phase 2 Trial of Icotrokinra for Patients with Ulcerative Colitis
articles.authors: Abreu MT, Siegmund B, Surace L, Erondu N, Chen M, Chachu K, Louis E, Matsuoka K, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Monoclonal antibodies targeting the interleukin-23 pathway are effective in treating inflammatory bowel disease. However, these therapies must be administered intravenously or by subcutaneous injection.
abstract.textZh: 靶向白介素-23途徑的單株抗體能有效治療炎症性腸病。然而，這些療法必須靜脈注射或皮下注射。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: We conducted a phase 2b, double-blind, randomized trial of oral icotrokinra, a peptide that blocks the interleukin-23 receptor, in adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis. Participants were assigned to receive icotrokinra at a once-daily dose of 400 mg, 200 mg, or 100 mg or placebo. The primary end point was clinical response at week 12. Secondary end points included clinical remission, remission of symptoms, and endoscopic improvement at week 12.
abstract.textZh: 我們在患有中度至重度活躍性潰瘍性結腸炎的成年人中進行了口服icotrokinra （一種阻斷白介素-23受體的肽）的2b期雙盲隨機試驗。參與者被分配接受每日一次劑量為400 mg、200 mg或100 mg的icotrokinra或安慰劑。主要終點為第12週的臨牀反應。次要終點包括第12週的臨牀緩解、症狀緩解和內視鏡改善。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 252 participants underwent randomization: 63 were assigned to the 400-mg group, 62 to the 200-mg group, 64 to the 100-mg group, and 63 to the placebo group. All the doses of icotrokinra were superior to placebo with respect to a clinical response at week 12, which occurred in 63% of the participants in the 400-mg group, 58% in the 200-mg group, and 55% in the 100-mg group, as compared with 27% in the placebo group (P<0.001 for all comparisons with placebo). The percentage of participants with clinical remission at week 12 was also significantly higher in the 400-mg group than in the placebo group (30% vs. 11%, P = 0.006), as were the percentage of participants with symptomatic remission (46% vs. 19%, P<0.001) and the percentage of participants with endoscopic improvement (37% vs. 14%, P = 0.002). Clinical remission at week 12 occurred in 24% of the participants in the 200-mg group (P = 0.054 for the comparison with placebo); in accordance with the fixed-sequence testing procedure to account for multiple comparisons, no further formal testing of secondary end points was conducted. Through week 28, the percentage of participants with adverse events was 60% in the 400-mg group, 66% in the 200-mg group, 66% in the 100-mg group, and 62% in the placebo group. For serious adverse events, the percentages were 2%, 5%, 0%, and 10%, respectively.
abstract.textZh: 共有252名參與者接受了隨機分組： 63名被分配到400毫克組， 62名分配到200毫克組， 64名分配到100毫克組， 63名分配到安慰劑組。 在第12週時，所有icotrokinra的劑量在臨牀反應方面均優於安慰劑， 400-mg組中63%的參與者、200-mg組中58%的參與者以及100-mg組中55%的參與者發生了臨牀反應，而安慰劑組中為27% (與安慰劑的所有比較的P < 0.001)。 第12週臨牀緩解的參與者百分比在400mg組中也顯著高於安慰劑組（ 30%對11% ， P = 0.006 ） ，症狀緩解的參與者百分比（ 46%對19% ， P < 0.001 ）和內視鏡改善的參與者百分比（ 37%對14% ， P = 0.002 ）也顯著高於安慰劑組。 200-mg組中24%的參與者在第12週發生臨牀緩解（與安慰劑比較的P = 0.054 ） ；根據考慮多重比較的固定序列測試程序，未進行次要終點的進一步正式測試。 在整個第28週， 400毫克組中發生不良事件的參與者百分比為60% ， 200毫克組中為66% ， 100毫克組中為66% ，安慰劑組中為62%。 對於嚴重不良事件，百分比分別為2%、5%、0%和10%。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among participants with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, a clinical response at week 12 was significantly more common with once-daily oral icotrokinra at each of three tested doses than with placebo. (Funded by Johnson & Johnson; ANTHEM-UC ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06049017.).
abstract.textZh: 在患有中度至重度活躍性潰瘍性結腸炎的參與者中，在三種測試劑量中，每日一次的口服icotrokinra在第12週的臨牀反應顯著高於安慰劑。（由Johnson & Johnson資助； ANTHEM-UC ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06049017。）。

articles.title: Ponatinib-Blinatumomab or Imatinib-Chemotherapy for Adult Ph-Positive ALL
articles.authors: Chiaretti S, Piciocchi A, Skert C, Leoncin M, Borlenghi E, Cattaneo C, Di Trani M, Elia L, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The outcome of Philadelphia-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph-positive ALL) has greatly improved with the use of tyrosine kinase inhibitors and immunotherapy.
abstract.textZh: 使用酪氨酸激酶抑制劑和免疫療法，費城陽性急性淋巴母細胞白血病（ Ph陽性ALL ）的結局大大改善。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this trial, we randomly assigned adult patients with Ph-positive ALL in a 2:1 ratio to receive ponatinib plus blinatumomab (intervention group) or imatinib plus chemotherapy (control group) as frontline treatment. A crossover to the intervention group was allowed for patients with persistence or reappearance of measurable residual disease in the control group. The primary end point was event-free survival.
abstract.textZh: 在這項試驗中，我們以2 ： 1的比例隨機分配Ph陽性的成年患者接受ponatinib加blinatumomab （幹預組）或imatinib加化療（對照組）作為一線治療。對照組中持續出現或再出現可測量殘留疾病的患者，允許與幹預組進行交叉。主要終點是無事件存活期。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 236 patients underwent randomization: 158 to the intervention group and 78 to the control group. The median age of the patients was 55 years (range, 24 to 82). At a median follow-up of 23.7 months, the estimated 24-month event-free survival was 86% in the intervention group and 67% in the control group (P<0.001). Survival with no measurable residual disease was 68% and 42%, respectively. At the end of induction, a complete hematologic response was observed in 94% of the patients in the intervention group and in 79% of those in the control group. After blinatumomab consolidation, a molecular response was observed in 71% and 49% of the patients, respectively. After crossover to the intervention group, 20 of 31 patients (64%) had a molecular response. Overall survival was 90% in the intervention group and 85% in the control group. The cumulative incidence of relapse was 5% and 13%, respectively. As of this report, only 19% of the patients in the intervention group had undergone hematopoietic stem-cell transplantation after having had a first complete hematologic response.
abstract.textZh: 共有236名患者接受隨機分組：介入組158名，對照組78名。 患者的中位年齡為55歲（範圍為24至82歲）。 在中位隨訪23.7個月時，介入組的24個月無事件存活率估計為86% ，對照組為67% (P < 0.001)。 無可測量殘留疾病的生存率分別為68%和42%。 在誘導結束時，在幹預組中94%的患者和對照組中79%的患者中觀察到完全的血液學反應。 Blinatumomab鞏固後，分別在71%和49%的患者中觀察到分子反應。 介入組交叉後， 31名患者中有20名（ 64 ％ ）出現分子反應。 整體存活率介入組為90% ，對照組為85%。 復發的累計發生率分別為5%和13%。 截至本報告，介入組中只有19%的患者在第一次完全血液學反應後進行了造血幹細胞移植。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: In this phase 3 trial, a frontline chemotherapy-free targeted and immunotherapeutic approach was superior to the use of imatinib and chemotherapy. (Funded by Associazione Italiana per la Ricerca sul Cancro and others; GIMEMA ALL2820 ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT04722848.).
abstract.textZh: 在這項3期試驗中，一線無化療靶向和免疫治療方法優於使用伊馬替尼和化療。（由Associazione Italiana per la Ricerca sul Cancro等資助； GIMEMA ALL2820 ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT04722848。）

articles.title: Lonvoguran Ziclumeran - In Vivo CRISPR Gene Editing in Hereditary Angioedema
articles.authors: Cohn DM, Gurugama P, Longhurst HJ, Aygören-Pürsün E, Craig TJ, Farkas H, Jacobs J, Lumry WR, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Hereditary angioedema is a rare and potentially life-threatening genetic condition characterized by recurrent and debilitating swelling attacks. Lonvoguran ziclumeran (lonvo-z) - an investigational, in vivo gene-editing treatment based on clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats (CRISPR) - is being developed as a single-dose treatment for hereditary angioedema.
abstract.textZh: 遺傳性血管性水腫是一種罕見且可能危及生命的遺傳疾病，其特徵是復發性和衰弱性腫脹發作。Lonvoguran ziclumeran (lonvo-z) -一種基於叢集規律間隔短回文重複序列(CRISPR)的研究性體內基因編輯治療-正在作為遺傳性血管水腫的單劑治療進行開發。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a phase 3, double-blind trial, we randomly assigned, in a 2:1 ratio, patients who were 16 years of age or older and had hereditary angioedema with C1 inhibitor deficiency to receive a single intravenous infusion of lonvo-z (at a dose of 50 mg) or placebo. The primary end point was the number of investigator-confirmed hereditary angioedema attacks per month (the monthly attack rate) from week 5 through week 28 after infusion.
abstract.textZh: 在一項3期雙盲試驗中，我們以2 ： 1的比例隨機分配16歲或以上且遺傳性血管性水腫伴C1抑制劑缺乏的患者接受單次靜脈輸注lonvo-z （劑量為50 mg ）或安慰劑。主要終點是從輸注後第5週到第28週，研究者確認的每月遺傳性血管性水腫發作的次數（每月發作率）。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 80 patients underwent randomization; 52 were assigned to receive lonvo-z and 28 to receive placebo. As of February 10, 2026, the median duration of follow-up was 7.5 months (range, 4.9 to 12.8). The least-squares mean monthly attack rate from weeks 5 through 28 was 0.26 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.15 to 0.45) in the lonvo-z group and 2.10 (95% CI, 1.55 to 2.86) in the placebo group (relative difference, -87%; 95% CI, -93 to -78; P<0.001). Adverse events that occurred during or after infusion of lonvo-z or placebo were reported in 92% and 86% of the patients in the lonvo-z and placebo groups, respectively, from day 1 through week 28. Among the adverse events that occurred during or after infusion and more often in the lonvo-z group than in the placebo group, the most common (occurring in >10% of the patients in the lonvo-z group) included infusion-related reaction, headache, fatigue, back pain, and upper respiratory tract infection. No serious or grade 3 or higher adverse events were reported in the lonvo-z group.
abstract.textZh: 共有80名患者接受隨機分組； 52名接受lonvo-z治療， 28名接受安慰劑治療。 截至2026年2月10日，隨訪持續時間中位數為7.5個月（範圍為4.9至12.8 ）。 第5週至第28週的最小二乘平均每月攻擊率在lonvo-z組為0.26 (95%可信區間[CI] ， 0.15至0.45) ，在安慰劑組為2.10 (95% CI ， 1.55至2.86) (相對差異為-87% ； 95% CI ， -93至-78 ； P < 0.001)。 從第1天到第28週，在注射lonvo-z或安慰劑期間或之後發生的不良事件分別在92%和86%的lonvo-z和安慰劑組患者中報告。 在輸注期間或輸注後發生的不良事件中， lonvo-z組比安慰劑組更常見，最常見的不良事件（發生在lonvo-z組中> 10%的患者中）包括輸注相關反應、頭痛、疲勞、背痛和上呼吸道感染。 Lonvo-z組中沒有嚴重或3級或更高的不良事件報告。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among patients with hereditary angioedema, a single intravenous infusion of lonvo-z resulted in a significantly lower rate of hereditary angioedema attacks than placebo. (Funded by Intellia Therapeutics; HAELO ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06634420.).
abstract.textZh: 在遺傳性血管性水腫患者中，單次靜脈注射lonvo-z導致遺傳性血管性水腫發作的發生率顯著低於安慰劑。（由Intellia Therapeutics資助； HAELO ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT06634420 ）。

articles.titleZh: Lonvoguran Ziclumeran -遺傳性血管水腫的體內CRISPR基因編輯

articles.title: Clinician Use of an Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Clinical Information Platform
articles.authors: Patel VR, Finlayson SG, Liu-Hass M, Ray M, Burk-Rafel J, Zack TI, Jena AB

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Despite growing interest in the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in medicine, empirical evidence on how clinicians use these tools is limited.
abstract.textZh: 儘管人們對在醫學中使用人工智慧（ AI ）的興趣越來越高，但關於臨牀醫生如何使用這些工具的實證證據仍然有限。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To characterize clinician use of an AI-enabled clinical information platform, the distribution of use across the clinical workforce, and the purpose of submitted queries.
abstract.textZh: 描述臨牀醫生對人工智能臨牀資訊平臺的使用、臨牀人員的使用分佈以及提交的查詢的目的。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: This cross-sectional study analyzed clinicians with National Provider Identifier-verified accounts of a commonly used AI-enabled clinical information platform, OpenEvidence, from January 1, 2024, through June 30, 2026. A large language model was used to classify the clinical purpose and topic areas of a stratified random sample of 38.8 million queries.
abstract.textZh: 這項橫斷面研究分析了2024年1月1日至2026年6月30日期間，經過國家提供者識別碼驗證的常用人工智慧臨牀資訊平臺OpenEvidence帳戶的臨牀醫生。使用大型語言模型對3880萬個查詢的分層隨機樣本的臨牀目的和主題領域進行分類。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: The number of active users and clinical queries, the share of queries relative to representation in the national workforce, and the clinical purpose and topic of queries were examined.
abstract.textZh: 檢查了活躍用戶和臨牀查詢的數量、查詢在國家勞動力中相對於代表性的份額，以及查詢的臨牀目的和主題。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Overall, 952 008 clinicians (58.5% female), including 556 200 physicians, submitted 271 million queries during the 2.5-year study period. Monthly active users increased from 355 in January 2024 to 703 265 in June 2026, and average monthly queries per active user rose from 18.0 to 39.5. Nurse practitioners (44.5) and physician assistants (44.5) submitted more queries per active user-month than physicians (37.1). A higher share of queries relative to the national workforce was submitted by physicians within a decade of graduation (use ratio, 2.54) and residents and fellows (1.84). Use was also higher than average among physicians specializing in oncology and hematology (use ratio, 2.00), internal medicine (1.88), and family medicine (1.80), but lower in procedural and diagnostic specialties (ophthalmology, 0.23; radiology, 0.24; orthopedics, 0.24). Most queries addressed clinical decision-making (51.9%), particularly treatment and management (33.1%), whereas diagnosis accounted for 13.9% of queries. Queries addressing topics outside physicians' own specialties ranged from 35% among oncologists and hematologists to 88% among emergency department physicians.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言，在為期2.5年的研究期間， 952 008名臨牀醫生（ 58.5 ％為女性） ，包括556 200名醫生，提交了2.71億次查詢。 每月活躍用戶從2024年1月的355增加到2026年6月的703 265 ，每個活躍用戶的平均每月查詢量從18.0增加到39.5。 護士從業人員（ 44.5 ）和醫師助理（ 44.5 ）在每個活躍使用者月份中提交的查詢多於醫師（ 37.1 ）。 相對於全國勞動力，醫生在畢業後十年內（使用率， 2.54 ）和居民和研究員（ 1.84 ）提交的查詢比例較高。 腫瘤科和血液科專科醫生（使用比率， 2.00 ）、內科（ 1.88 ）和家庭醫學（ 1.80 ）的使用率也高於平均水平，但在手術和診斷專科（眼科， 0.23 ；放射科， 0.24 ；骨科， 0.24 ）的使用率較低。 大多數查詢涉及臨牀決策（ 51.9 ％ ） ，特別是治療和管理（ 33.1 ％ ） ，而診斷佔查詢的13.9 ％。 針對醫生自身專業以外主題的查詢範圍從腫瘤科醫生和血液科醫生的35%到急診科醫生的88%不等。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
abstract.text: Over 2.5 years, more than 950 000 US clinicians submitted greater than 270 million queries to an AI-enabled clinical information platform. Use varied across clinician types, specialties, and career stages and was frequently for treatment decisions rather than diagnostic tasks.
abstract.textZh: 在過去的2.5年中，超過95萬名美國臨牀醫生向人工智能臨牀信息平臺提交了超過2.7億個查詢。使用因臨牀醫生類型、專業和職業階段而異，經常用於治療決策而不是診斷任務。

articles.titleZh: 臨牀醫師使用人工智慧臨牀資訊平臺

articles.title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Non-Insulin-Treated Type 2 Diabetes
articles.authors: Oser TK, Martens T, Ruedy KJ, Bergford S, Calhoun P, Chang KL, Kramer ES, Klug BA, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) has been shown to be beneficial in persons with type 1 diabetes and others with insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, but its role in the treatment of persons with type 2 diabetes not being treated with insulin has needed further study.
abstract.textZh: 持續葡萄糖監測（ CGM ）已被證明對1型糖尿病患者和其他胰島素治療的2型糖尿病患者有益，但其在治療未使用胰島素治療的2型糖尿病患者中的作用需要進一步研究。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In a 26-week trial conducted at 22 primary care practices in the United States, we randomly assigned adults with type 2 diabetes who were not using insulin to either CGM or routine care (control). The primary outcome was the glycated hemoglobin level at 26 weeks. Key CGM-measured secondary outcomes were tested hierarchically to control the type I error rate.
abstract.textZh: 在美國22個初級護理實踐中進行的為期26週的試驗中，我們隨機將未使用胰島素的2型糖尿病成年人分配到CGM或常規護理（對照）。主要結果是26週時的糖化血紅蛋白濃度。對CGM測量的關鍵次要結果進行分層測試，以控制I型錯誤率。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: A total of 145 participants were assigned to the CGM group, and 138 to the routine-care group. Participants ranged in age from 21 to 84 years. The mean (±SD) glycated hemoglobin level decreased from 8.8±1.3% at baseline to 7.2±1.1% at 26 weeks in the CGM group and from 8.7±1.2% to 8.0±1.4% in the routine-care group (adjusted mean difference, -0.9 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -1.1 to -0.6; P<0.001). The mean percentage of time that the CGM-measured glucose level was in the glucose-level range of 70 to 180 mg per deciliter was 21 percentage points higher (95% CI, 16 to 26) with CGM than with routine care (P<0.001). The between-group difference in the percentage of time that the glucose level was below 54 mg per deciliter was -0.17 percentage points (95% CI, -0.27 to -0.11; P<0.001 for noninferiority); the difference in the percentage of time that the glucose level was below 70 mg per deciliter was -0.20 percentage points (95% CI, -0.43 to -0.09; P<0.001 for noninferiority; P = 0.004 for superiority). No severe hypoglycemia events were reported.
abstract.textZh: 共有145名參與者被分配到CGM組， 138名被分配到日常護理組。 參與者的年齡範圍從21歲到84歲不等。 CGM組的平均(± SD)糖化血紅蛋白濃度從基線時的8.8 ± 1.3%降至26週時的7.2 ± 1.1% ，常規護理組從8.7 ± 1.2%降至8.0 ± 1.4% (調整平均差值， -0.9個百分點； 95%置信區間[CI] ， -1.1至-0.6 ； P < 0.001)。 CGM測量葡萄糖濃度在每分升70至180毫克葡萄糖濃度範圍內的平均時間百分比（ 95% CI ， 16至26 ）比日常護理高21個百分點（ P < 0.001 ）。 葡萄糖水平低於54毫克/分升的時間百分比組間差異為-0.17個百分點（ 95% CI ， -0.27至-0.11 ；非劣效性為P < 0.001 ） ；葡萄糖水平低於70毫克/分升的時間百分比差異為-0.20個百分點（ 95% CI ， -0.43至-0.09 ；非劣效性為P < 0.001 ；優效性為P = 0.004 ）。 未報告嚴重低血糖事件。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among adults with type 2 diabetes that was not being treated with insulin and was being managed in a primary care setting, the use of CGM led to a greater reduction in the glycated hemoglobin level and to a lower risk of hyperglycemia than routine care. (Funded by Dexcom; CONNECT ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06601166.).
abstract.textZh: 在沒有接受胰島素治療並且在初級保健環境中進行治療的2型糖尿病成人中，使用CGM導致糖化血紅蛋白水平大幅降低，並且比常規護理更低的高血糖風險。（由Dexcom資助；連接ClinicalTrials.gov編號， NCT06601166。）

articles.titleZh: 非胰島素治療2型糖尿病的持續血糖監測

articles.title: Intermittent or Continuous Renal-Replacement Therapy in Acute Kidney Injury
articles.authors: Gaudry S, Boubaya M, Louis G, Chaïbi K, de Montmollin E, Bohé J, Desgrouas M, Devautour C, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: The preferred method of renal-replacement therapy for acute kidney injury in critically ill patients remains uncertain.
abstract.textZh: 重症患者急性腎損傷的首選腎臟替代治療方法仍然不確定。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: In this multicenter, open-label, noninferiority trial, we randomly assigned critically ill adults with acute kidney injury who had indications for renal-replacement therapy to undergo intermittent hemodialysis or continuous renal-replacement therapy as the initial treatment. The primary outcome was a major adverse kidney event - defined as death, dependence on renal-replacement therapy, or a serum creatinine concentration more than 25% above the baseline value - by day 90.
abstract.textZh: 在這項多中心、開放標籤、非劣效性試驗中，我們將有腎臟替代療法適應症的急性腎臟損傷重症成人隨機分配接受間歇性血液透析或連續腎臟替代療法作為初始治療。到第90天，主要結果是主要的不良腎臟事件-定義為死亡、對腎臟替代療法的依賴，或血清肌酐濃度超過基線值25%。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: The trial was stopped early after sequential interim analyses showed a sustained signal of higher mortality with intermittent hemodialysis than with continuous renal-replacement therapy. A total of 554 patients underwent randomization, with 272 patients assigned to undergo intermittent hemodialysis and 282 to undergo continuous renal-replacement therapy; 535 patients (260 in the intermittent group and 275 in the continuous group) were included in the intention-to-treat population. A major adverse kidney event occurred by day 90 in 203 patients (78.1%) in the intermittent group and in 197 patients (71.6%) in the continuous group (adjusted absolute risk difference, 6.28 percentage points; 95% confidence interval [CI], -1.22 to 13.79). Death by day 90 occurred in 164 patients (63.1%) and in 147 patients (53.5%), respectively. Kaplan-Meier mortality estimates at day 90 were 63.3% and 53.6% (hazard ratio, 1.30; 95% CI, 1.04 to 1.63). The most common complication potentially related to acute kidney injury or renal-replacement therapy was hypotension, which occurred in 179 patients (68.8%) in the intermittent group and in 183 patients (66.5%) in the continuous group.
abstract.textZh: 在序列期中分析顯示間歇性血液透析的死亡率高於連續性腎臟替代療法的持續信號後，試驗提前停止。 共有554名患者接受隨機分組，其中272名患者被分配接受間歇性血液透析， 282名患者接受連續性腎臟替代治療； 535名患者（間歇性組260名，連續性組275名）被納入意向性治療人羣。 間歇組的203名患者（ 78.1 ％ ）和連續組的197名患者（ 71.6 ％ ）在第90天發生了重大不良腎臟事件（調整絕對風險差， 6.28個百分點； 95 ％置信區間[CI] ， -1.22至13.79 ）。 第90天死亡的患者分別爲164名（ 63.1% ）和147名（ 53.5% ）。 第90天的Kaplan-Meier死亡率估計值為63.3%和53.6% （風險比， 1.30 ； 95% CI ， 1.04至1.63 ）。 可能與急性腎損傷或腎替代療法相關的最常見併發症是低血壓，發生在間歇性組的179名患者（ 68.8 ％ ）和連續組的183名患者（ 66.5 ％ ）中。

abstract.label: CONCLUSIONS
abstract.text: Among critically ill patients with acute kidney injury who had indications for renal-replacement therapy, intermittent hemodialysis as the initial treatment approach was not shown to be noninferior to continuous renal-replacement therapy with respect to major adverse kidney events by day 90 and was associated with higher mortality. (Funded by the French Ministry of Health; ICRAKI ClinicalTrials.gov number, NCT06032884.).
abstract.textZh: 對於有腎臟替代療法適應症的急性腎臟損傷重症患者，間歇性血液透析作為初始治療方法，在第90天的重大腎臟不良事件方面並未顯示出不劣於連續性腎臟替代療法，並且與更高的死亡率相關。（由法國衛生部資助； ICRAKI ClinicalTrials.gov編號： NCT06032884 ）。

articles.titleZh: 急性腎臟損傷的間歇性或連續性腎臟替代療法

articles.title: Isoflurane-Based Inhaled Sedation in Mechanically Ventilated Adults With Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure: The SAVE-ICU Randomized Clinical Trial
articles.authors: Jerath A, Slessarev M, Martin C, D'Aragon F, Carrier FM, Senaratne J, Meggison H, Hooper J, et al.

abstract.label: IMPORTANCE
abstract.text: Rigorous evidence for inhaled sedation using isoflurane in mechanically ventilated patients with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (AHRF) is limited.
abstract.textZh: 在機械通氣的急性低氧性呼吸衰竭(AHRF)患者中使用異氟醚吸入鎮靜的嚴格證據有限。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To evaluate whether an inhaled sedation strategy lowers hospital mortality compared with usual care intravenous sedation strategy in mechanically ventilated adults with AHRF.
abstract.textZh: 評估吸入鎮靜策略是否比機械通氣的AHRF成人靜脈鎮靜策略降低住院死亡率。

abstract.label: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Pragmatic, effectiveness, open-label, superiority, randomized clinical trial in 14 intensive care units (ICUs) in Canada. Adults (≥18 years) receiving sedation for less than 72 hours and receiving mechanical ventilation for AHRF from non-COVID respiratory failure (ratio of partial pressure of arterial oxygen [Pao2] to fraction of inspired oxygen [Fio2] <300 mm Hg) or COVID-19 were enrolled between September 2020 and March 2025 with follow-up through June 2025.
abstract.textZh: 在加拿大14個重症監護病房（ ICU ）進行的務實、有效、標籤開放、優越、隨機臨牀試驗。在2020年9月至2025年3月期間，因非COVID呼吸衰竭（動脈氧分壓[Pao2]與吸入氧分數[Fio2] < 300 mm Hg的比率）或COVID-19而接受鎮靜治療少於72小時並接受AHRF機械通氣的成年人（ ≥ 18歲）入組，隨訪至2025年6月。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Patients were randomized to an inhaled sedation strategy using isoflurane with intravenous adjuncts as clinically needed or to a usual intravenous sedation care strategy. Sedatives were titrated to achieve the desired target sedation score guided by clinical teams and continued until extubation or death.
abstract.textZh: 患者被隨機分配到吸入鎮靜策略，根據臨牀需要使用帶有靜脈輔助的異氟醚，或通常的靜脈鎮靜護理策略。在臨牀團隊的指導下，滴定鎮靜劑以達到所需的目標鎮靜分數，並持續到拔管或死亡。

abstract.label: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
abstract.text: Primary outcome was all-cause hospital mortality. Secondary outcomes included ICU- and ventilator-free days at day 30; hospital-free days at day 60; use of refractory hypoxemia adjunctive therapies; delirium- and coma-free days at day 14; and quality-of-life and disability scores at 3 months.
abstract.textZh: 主要結果為全因住院死亡率。次要結果包括第30天無ICU和呼吸機天數；第60天無住院天數；使用難治性低氧血症輔助治療；第14天無譫妄和昏迷天數；以及第3個月的生活品質和殘疾評分。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Of 786 patients randomized, 780 were included in the primary analysis (mean age, 61.1 years; 34.0% female; 73.7% non-COVID AHRF, mean Pao2:Fio2 ratio, 152.6 mm Hg); 385 in the inhaled sedation and 395 in the intravenous sedation groups. In the inhaled sedation group, 49.9% to 55.4% of patients received concomitant intravenous sedation on any day during the first 14 days after randomization. At hospital discharge, 161 of 379 patients (42.5%) in the inhaled sedation group had died, compared with 171 of 390 patients (43.8%) in the intravenous sedation group (risk ratio, 0.98 [95% CI, 0.84 to 1.14]; P = .85). There was no effect modification in prespecified subgroup analyses for age, sex, and COVID-19 status. ICU-, ventilator-, and hospital-free days were similar between groups. The inhaled sedation group received more adjunctive therapies for hypoxemia (239 [63.9%] vs 214 [55.0%]; between-group difference, 8.89% [95% CI, 1.95% to 15.83%]) and had fewer delirium- and coma-free days (between-group difference, -0.95 [95% CI, -1.69 to -0.22]). There was no difference in quality-of-life and disability scores between groups.

articles.title: Benzodiazepine Use Early in Pregnancy and Risk for Congenital Malformations
articles.authors: Fung K, Sujan AC, Bateman BT, Straub L, Hernandez-Diaz S, Brill G, Zhu Y, Cohen LS, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Existing data on malformations associated with benzodiazepine use in pregnancy are conflicting.
abstract.textZh: 與懷孕期間使用苯二氮卓類藥物相關的畸形現有數據相互矛盾。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess the risk for major congenital malformations from first-trimester exposure to benzodiazepines.
abstract.textZh: 評估因暴露於苯二氮卓類藥物而導致的主要先天性畸形的風險。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Population-based U.S. cohort study.
abstract.textZh: 以人羣為基礎的美國隊列研究。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Medicaid (2000-2018) and Merative MarketScan (2003-2020) databases.
abstract.textZh: Medicaid （ 2000-2018 ）和Merative MarketScan （ 2003-2020 ）資料庫。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: Pregnant persons enrolled from 90 days before pregnancy to 30 days after delivery, and their live-born infants enrolled for 90 days after birth.
abstract.textZh: 孕婦於懷孕前90天至分娩後30天入組，其活產嬰兒於分娩後90天入組。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Exposure was defined as at least 1 fill of a benzodiazepine in the first trimester. Primary outcomes were any major congenital malformation and organ-specific malformations previously associated with benzodiazepine exposure. The investigators estimated relative risks (RRs) comparing exposed versus unexposed pregnancies with propensity score fine stratification weights to control for confounders. An RR of 1.3 or higher was prespecified as clinically significant.
abstract.textZh: 暴露定義為在妊娠早期至少注射1次苯二氮卓類藥物。主要結果是先前與苯二氮卓類藥物接觸有關的任何重大先天性畸形和器官特異性畸形。研究者估計相對風險(RR) ，將暴露與未暴露的懷孕進行比較，其中傾向評分為精細分層權重，以控制混雜因素。預先指定RR為1.3或更高，具有臨牀顯著性。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: In total, 51 339 of 2 478 434 (2.1%) publicly insured and 27 779 of 1 750 721 (1.6%) commercially insured pregnancies had benzodiazepine exposure. The adjusted absolute risks for any malformation in exposed versus unexposed pregnancies were 4.0% versus 4.1% for Medicaid and 4.9% versus 4.8% for MarketScan. The pooled adjusted RR was 0.99 (95% CI, 0.96 to 1.03). Associations with organ-specific malformations were not consistently observed in sensitivity analyses, nor was a dose-response relationship observed. Analyses of different benzodiazepines yielded similar results. The risk for selected organ-specific malformations was increased in some analyses of coexposure to benzodiazepines and other psychoactive medications, but a consistent pattern did not emerge.
abstract.textZh: 總體而言， 2 478 434人中有51 339人（ 2.1 ％ ）投保公共保險， 1 750 721人中有27 779人（ 1.6 ％ ）投保商業保險的懷孕有苯二氮卓類藥物暴露。暴露與未暴露妊娠中任何畸形的調整絕對風險為4.0 ％ ，而醫療補助為4.1 ％ ， MarketScan為4.9 ％和4.8 ％。匯集的調整後RR為0.99 （ 95% CI ， 0.96至1.03 ）。敏感性分析中未持續觀察到與器官特異性畸形的關聯，也未觀察到劑量反應關係。不同苯二氮卓類藥物的分析得到了類似的結果。在一些共暴露於苯二氮卓類藥物和其他精神作用藥物的分析中，特定器官特異性畸形的風險增加，但沒有出現一致的模式。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Potential nondifferential exposure and outcome misclassification; analyses restricted to malformations prevalent at birth.
abstract.textZh: 潛在的非差異暴露和結果錯誤分類；分析僅限於出生時普遍存在的畸形。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: No substantial increase in the risk for malformations was consistently identified across data sources. Findings from coexposure analyses were inconsistent and warrant further study.
abstract.textZh: 各種資料來源均未發現畸形風險的顯著增加。共同暴露分析的結果不一致，需要進一步研究。

abstract.text: National Institute of Child Health and Human Development.
abstract.textZh: 國家兒童健康與人類發展研究所。

articles.title: How Would You Screen This 26-Year-Old Woman for Cervical Cancer? Grand Rounds Discussion From Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
articles.authors: Smith CC, Chelmow D, Freund KM, Burns RB

abstract.text: Cervical cancer is the third most common gynecologic cancer, with more than 13 000 new cases diagnosed in 2025. The incidence of and mortality from cervical cancer vary across racial and ethnic groups and in persons living in medically underserved or geographically isolated areas, with half of all cervical cancers occurring in women who are underscreened or have never been screened. Persistent infection with high-risk types of human papillomavirus (HPV) is the most important risk factor for cervical cancer and is associated with nearly all cases. Although genital tract HPV infection is common, most HPV infections are transient, and cervical cancer occurs in only a small portion of patients with HPV. For decades, cervical cancer screening relied on annual cytologic assessment. A growing understanding of the role of HPV infection in the natural progression of cervical cancer has led to updated screening recommendations from the American Cancer Society and the Women's Preventive Services Initiative, as well as a draft update from the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force. These recommendations include primary HPV testing as a preferred screening strategy and include an option for self-collected specimens for HPV testing. Here, 2 experts in this field, a primary care physician and an obstetrics and gynecology physician, debate how to apply these guidelines when screening a patient for cervical cancer. They discuss a range of screening options and consider the challenges of applying these guidelines across different age groups and in patients at increased risk.

articles.title: Delirium
articles.authors: Golden BP, Vasilevskis EE

abstract.text: Delirium is a common, acute confusional state that is associated with adverse patient, caregiver, and health system outcomes. All patients are at risk for delirium, although those with advanced age or acute infection and those taking sedatives and anticholinergics are at greater risk. The pathophysiology of delirium is complex and includes neuronal injury, inflammation, metabolic imbalance, and blood-brain barrier disruption. It is important to note that delirium is preventable; recognizing people at risk and identifying and addressing predisposing and precipitating factors is paramount. No single intervention or medication has been shown to be effective in treating delirium; therefore, standard-of-care treatments rely on multifaceted strategies to address contributing factors.

articles.title: Effect of Fluvoxamine and Metformin for Fatigue in Patients With Long COVID : An Adaptive Randomized Trial
articles.authors: Reis G, Dos Santos Moreira Silva EA, Medeiros Silva DC, Thabane L, Santiago Ferreira T, Reis LLF, Figueiredo Guimaraes Almeida AP, Menezes Amaral M, et al.

abstract.label: BACKGROUND
abstract.text: Postacute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection (long COVID) presents a therapeutic challenge, with fatigue being a common, debilitating symptom.
abstract.textZh: SARS-CoV-2感染（長期COVID ）的急性後遺症是一種治療挑戰，疲勞是一種常見的衰弱症狀。

abstract.label: OBJECTIVE
abstract.text: To assess the efficacy of fluvoxamine and metformin to treat long COVID fatigue.
abstract.textZh: 評估氟伏沙明和二甲雙胍治療長期COVID疲勞的功效。

abstract.label: DESIGN
abstract.text: Randomized, placebo-controlled, adaptive trial. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT06128967).
abstract.textZh: 隨機、安慰劑對照、適應性試驗。（ ClinicalTrials.gov ： NCT06128967 ）。

abstract.label: SETTING
abstract.text: Outpatient sites in Brazil.
abstract.textZh: 巴西的門診部位。

abstract.label: PARTICIPANTS
abstract.text: 399 adults with fatigue 90 days to 24 months after confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection.
abstract.textZh: 399名成人在確診SARS-CoV-2感染後90天至24個月內感到疲勞。

abstract.label: INTERVENTION
abstract.text: Participants were randomly assigned to fluvoxamine (100 mg twice daily [BID]), extended-release metformin (750 mg BID [n = 71] from October 2023 to April 2024; reduced to 500 mg BID [n = 40] in May 2024 after a protocol amendment until the group was stopped for futility in September 2024), or a matching placebo, each for 60 days with follow-up to day 90.
abstract.textZh: 參與者被隨機分配到氟伏沙明（ 100毫克，每日兩次[BID] ）、延長釋放二甲雙胍（ 2023年10月至2024年4月為750毫克BID [n = 71] ；在計畫書修正後於2024年5月降至500毫克BID [n = 40] ，直到2024年9月該組因無效而停止服用）或相應的安慰劑，每種治療60天，並追蹤至第90天。

abstract.label: MEASUREMENTS
abstract.text: Change in Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS) score.
abstract.textZh: 疲勞嚴重程度量表(FSS)分數的變化。

abstract.label: RESULTS
abstract.text: Median baseline FSS scores ranged from 5.6 to 5.9 across all study groups. The treatment effect on FSS score for fluvoxamine versus placebo showed a mean difference of -0.43 at day 60 and -0.58 at day 90; both had a posterior probability of superiority of 99%. Fluvoxamine also improved quality-of-life scores with a high posterior probability of superiority. Findings for metformin were inconclusive. Incidence of adverse events was lower for fluvoxamine (24.0%) than for metformin, 750 mg BID (45.1%); metformin, 500 mg BID (42.5%); and placebo (35.5%). Grade 3 or higher adverse events were rare (≤2.7%), with no treatment-related deaths.
abstract.textZh: 所有研究組的基線FSS分數中位數範圍為5.6至5.9。氟伏沙明與安慰劑對FSS評分的治療效果顯示，第60天時的平均差異為-0.43 ，第90天時的平均差異為-0.58 ；兩者的後天優勢概率為99%。Fluvoxamine還改善了生活質量分數，具有較高的優越性後期概率。二甲雙胍的結果尚無定論。氟伏沙明（ 24.0% ）的不良事件發生率低於二甲雙胍（ 750 mg BID ， 45.1% ）、二甲雙胍（ 500 mg BID ， 42.5% ）和安慰劑（ 35.5% ）。3級或以上不良事件罕見（ ≤ 2.7% ） ，且無治療相關死亡。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: The results were inconclusive for metformin because of a dose change recommended by the data safety and monitoring committee due to adverse effects causing study withdrawal and early termination. The benefit of fluvoxamine after 90 days is unknown. The trial did not address other long COVID symptoms.
abstract.textZh: 由於數據安全和監測委員會建議改變劑量，導致研究退出和提前終止的不良影響，因此二甲雙胍的結果尚無定論。氟伏沙明90天後的益處尚不清楚。該試驗沒有解決其他長期的COVID症狀。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Fluvoxamine shows potential for improving long COVID-associated fatigue and quality of life.
abstract.textZh: 氟伏沙明顯示出改善長期COVID相關疲勞和生活質量的潛力。

abstract.text: The Latona Foundation.
abstract.textZh: Latona基金會。

articles.title: Pharmacologic Treatments for Females With Menopausal Vasomotor Symptoms: A Clinical Guideline From the American College of Physicians
articles.authors: Qaseem A, Mackey K, Yost J, Shekelle PG, Shamliyan TA, Cross JT, Clinical Guidelines Committee of the American College of Physicians

abstract.label: DESCRIPTION
abstract.text: The American College of Physicians (ACP) developed this clinical guideline on pharmacologic treatments for internal medicine physicians and other clinicians caring in outpatient settings for females with menopausal vasomotor symptoms.
abstract.textZh: 美國醫師學會（ ACP ）為內科醫生和其他臨牀醫生開發了這項臨牀治療指南，這些醫生在門診環境中為更年期血管舒縮症狀的女性提供護理。

abstract.label: METHODS
abstract.text: The ACP Clinical Guidelines Committee developed this guideline based on systematic reviews on effectiveness, comparative effectiveness, harms, public and patient values and preferences, and economic evidence of pharmacologic treatments for females with menopausal vasomotor symptoms using the GRADE (Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation) approach.
abstract.textZh: ACP臨牀指南委員會基於對有效性、比較有效性、危害、公眾和患者價值觀和偏好的系統審查，以及使用GRADE （建議分級、評估、發展和評估）方法對更年期血管舒張症徵狀的女性進行藥物治療的經濟證據，制定了本指南。

abstract.label: RECOMMENDATION
abstract.text: In females who are seeking treatment of vasomotor symptoms.
abstract.textZh: 正在尋求血管舒張症狀治療的女性。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: First-line treatments.
abstract.textZh: 一線治療。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: ACP recommends that clinicians initiate one of the following (strong recommendation): estrogen in combination with progestogen in females with a uterus (high-certainty evidence) or estrogen monotherapy in females without a uterus (high-certainty evidence).
abstract.textZh: ACP建議臨牀醫生進行以下任一治療（強烈建議） ：雌激素與孕激素合併治療有子宮的女性（高確定性證據） ，或雌激素單一治療無子宮的女性（高確定性證據）。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: Second-line treatments.
abstract.textZh: 二線治療。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: ACP suggests that clinicians use one of the following in females who have contraindications to or do not tolerate first-line treatment (conditional recommendation): serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, either desvenlafaxine or venlafaxine (moderate-certainty evidence).
abstract.textZh: ACP建議臨牀醫生對一線治療有禁忌症或不耐受一線治療的女性使用以下藥物之一（有條件建議） ：血清素-去甲腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑，無論是去芬拉法辛還是文拉法辛（中等確定性證據）。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: Third-line treatments.
abstract.textZh: 三線治療。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: ACP suggests that clinicians use one of the following in females who have contraindications to or do not tolerate first-line or second-line treatment (conditional recommendation): selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, either escitalopram or paroxetine (low-certainty evidence); the gabapentinoid gabapentin (low-certainty evidence); or neurokinin receptor antagonists, either elinzanetant or fezolinetant (moderate-certainty evidence).
abstract.textZh: ACP建議臨牀醫生在具有一線或二線治療禁忌症或不耐受一線或二線治療的女性中使用以下藥物之一（有條件建議） ：選擇性血清素再攝取抑制劑，無論是escitalopram還是paroxetine （低確定性證據） ；加巴噴丁類加巴噴丁（低確定性證據） ；或神經激肽受體拮抗劑，無論是elinzanetant還是fezolinetant （中等確定性證據）。

abstract.label: UNLABELLED
abstract.text: When selecting a treatment of vasomotor symptoms, clinicians should use an informed decision-making approach and discuss benefits, harms, contraindications, comorbid conditions, values and preferences, financial burden, and access to and availability of treatments.
abstract.textZh: 在選擇血管舒縮症狀的治療時，臨牀醫生應使用知情的決策方法，並討論益處、危害、禁忌症、合併症狀、價值觀和偏好、經濟負擔以及治療的獲取和可用性。

abstract.textZh: 針對VMS的女性進行至少8週合格藥物的隨機試驗，報告VMS頻率和嚴重程度、更年期相關的生活質量（ QOL ）、睡眠質量、子宮內膜增生或癌症和/或嚴重不良事件（ SAE ） ；美國食品藥物管理局和歐洲藥物管理局標籤為其他危害。

abstract.label: DATA EXTRACTION
abstract.text: Data were abstracted by 1 reviewer and verified by a second reviewer. Independent, dual risk-of-bias assessments were performed. Certainty of evidence (COE) was assessed by 1 reviewer and overread by a second reviewer.
abstract.textZh: 數據由1名審核人員提取，並由第二名審核人員驗證。進行了獨立的雙重偏見風險評估。證據確定性(COE)由1名審核人員評估，並由第二名審核人員過度閱讀。

abstract.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
abstract.text: Ninety trials were included. COE was low to moderate for most comparisons. Compared with placebo, estrogens with or without progestogens, conjugated estrogen with bazedoxifene (CE/BZA), and oxybutynin reduced VMS frequency and severity. Compared with placebo, neurokinin receptor antagonists (NKRAs), serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors (SNRIs), selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs), gabapentin, and progestogens reduced VMS frequency but not severity. Estrogen efficacy varied by dose but not route. Estrogens with and without progestogens, CE/BZA, NKRAs, SNRIs, and SSRIs improved menopause-related QoL; gabapentin, NKRAs, oxybutynin, SNRIs, and SSRIs improved sleep quality. Few SAEs were reported. Evidence was insufficient for patient values and preferences. Estrogens with or without progestogens are of high economic value (high COE). The NKRA fezolinetant has low value (moderate COE).
abstract.textZh: 納入了九十項試驗。大多數比較的COE為低至中等。與安慰劑相比，有或沒有孕激素的雌激素、與巴塞多昔芬（ CE/BZA ）結合的雌激素和奧昔布寧降低了VMS的頻率和嚴重程度。與安慰劑相比，神經激肽受體拮抗劑（ NKRA ）、血清素去甲腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑（ SNRI ）、選擇性血清素再攝取抑制劑（ SSRI ）、加巴噴丁和孕激素降低了VMS頻率，但不降低嚴重程度。雌激素療效因劑量而異，但不因途徑而異。含有和不含孕激素的雌激素、CE/BZA、NKRA、SNRI和SSRI改善了更年期相關的QOL ；加巴噴丁、NKRA、奧昔布寧、SNRI和SSRI改善了睡眠質量。報告的嚴重不良事件很少。證據不足以反映患者的價值觀和偏好。有或沒有孕激素的雌激素具有高經濟價值（高COE ）。NKRA fezolinetant具有低值（中度COE ）。

abstract.label: LIMITATIONS
abstract.text: Most studies were short-term and were not designed to evaluate SAEs or long-term harms. Observational studies that could address long-term harms were not included.
abstract.textZh: 大多數研究都是短期的，並非用於評估嚴重不良事件或長期危害。不包括可以解決長期危害的觀察性研究。

abstract.label: CONCLUSION
abstract.text: Estrogens reduced VMS frequency and severity and improved QoL (with or without progestogens and with BZA). NKRAs, SNRIs, and SSRIs improved VMS frequency, QoL, and sleep. Estrogens with and without progestogens were of high economic value. Harms data were limited. Little comparative information exists.
abstract.textZh: 雌激素降低了VMS的頻率和嚴重程度，並改善了QOL （有或沒有孕激素和BZA ）。NKRA、SNRI和SSRI改善了VMS頻率、QOL和睡眠。含有和不含孕激素的雌激素具有很高的經濟價值。危害數據有限。對比信息很少。
